basic_details.scholarship_name: National University of Singapore (NUS) Research Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: National University of Singapore (NUS) & Ministry of Education (MOE, Singapore)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge, Bukit Timah, and Outram Campuses, Singapore)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all graduate research disciplines: School of Computing (CS, AI, Information Systems), College of Design and Engineering, Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, Faculty of Science, NUS Business School, Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, Faculty of Law.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~800 to 1,000 active research scholars supported concurrently across faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; awarded strictly based on academic and research merit (typically 15 to 30 Pakistani research scholars awarded/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's by Research; up to 4 years for PhD (subject to satisfactory progress and qualifying examination)

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants of all nationalities with outstanding academic records
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum second-class upper or first-class honors for Master's; Bachelor's with first-class honors or Master's degree (18 years) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalent to First Class Honours (CAP 4.00+ / 5.00 in Singapore grading or 3.70+ / 4.00 CGPA).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training and high grades in core subjects related to the proposed research discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before intake start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Peer-reviewed publications, open-source projects, and research presentations heavily prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 85 (writing 22+) or IELTS Academic min 6.0-6.5 (School of Computing requires IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90).

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite graduate researchers across science, engineering, and computing.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not be concurrently holding another full scholarship or fellowship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition subsidy provided through the Singapore Ministry of Education (MOE) Service Obligation / Tuition Grant.

admission_application_fee.details: NUS graduate application fee (SGD $50 per program) paid online by applicant.

accommodation.details: Paid out of monthly stipend; on-campus graduate housing at UTown (College Green, Prince George's Park Residences ~SGD $600–900/mo).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: Pre-qualifying exam: SGD $2,200/month for international PhD candidates (~PKR 465,000/month); Post-qualifying exam (after passing PhD qualifying examination): increased to SGD $2,700/month (~PKR 570,000/month). For Master's: SGD $1,500/month.
monthly_stipend.amount: SGD $2,200 to $2,700 / month for PhD (~PKR 465,000 to 570,000 / month)

airfare.details: International travel expenses to Singapore borne by student.

visa_fee.details: Singapore Student's Pass application fee (SGD $30) and issuance fee (SGD $60) paid by applicant on ICA portal.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory NUS Group Personal Accident and Medical Insurance Scheme included in student services.
health_insurance.amount: 100% covered under NUS student health plan

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at campus food courts across Kent Ridge (~SGD $4 to $6 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to high-performance computing clusters (NSCC), advanced cleanrooms, and library facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: NUS Faculty Conference Travel Grants (up to SGD $2,500 per conference) available for presenting accepted papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Internal Shuttle Bus (ISB) network operating across Kent Ridge and UTown campuses is 100% free.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge, Singapore).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #8 QS World University Rankings 2025; #1 in Asia; Top 6 globally in Computer Science and Engineering.
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Medicine
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with First Class Honours, GRE/GATE score (for non-Singapore graduates), English test score, and research statement.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: School of Computing is among the most selective worldwide; College of Design and Engineering has a slightly broader intake pool.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the box applying for the 'NUS Research Scholarship' on the central Graduate Admission System (GDA3) application form.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the NUS GDA3 online application portal, select your research degree, and check the box for NUS Research Scholarship.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Research faculty lab pages and ongoing research projects at NUS (August-October).
2. Create account on NUS GDA3 application portal.
3. Select target degree program and department.
4. Check the box to apply for NUS Research Scholarship.
5. Upload Statement of Purpose, research proposal, CV, transcripts, GRE, and TOEFL/IELTS scores.
6. Register 2 academic referees who upload confidential recommendation letters.
7. Pay application fee (SGD $50) before deadline (typically November 1 for August intake).
9. Receive admission and scholarship offer in April/May.
10. Complete Student's Pass registration with Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic assessment through central NUS GDA3 portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 2 referees via NUS electronic referee system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic trajectory, research accomplishments, why NUS was chosen, and prospective faculty alignment.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal (1-2 pages) describing research questions, background literature, and proposed methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, GPA, and software/engineering competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Departmental faculty conduct 30-45 minute technical video interviews on domain depth and research methodology.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General test is required for applicants from non-Singapore universities (verbal/quant 320+, analytical writing 3.5+).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original certified transcripts and degree certificates; verified upon matriculation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport
Complete transcripts for 16-year or 18-year education with grading scale
Confidential reports submitted by former university professors
Structured statement outlining research vision and proposed doctoral topic
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aligned with prospective NUS faculty lab

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official GRE General score report + TOEFL (85+) or IELTS (6.5+)

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is August (opens August, closes November 1). January intake has an earlier deadline (closes May 15).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior undergraduate/master's GPA, First Class Honours distinction)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: GRE score evaluated alongside academic transcripts
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Committee and Vice Dean of Research at respective NUS faculties.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening (GPA + GRE + Publications) -> Technical faculty interview -> Faculty ranking and central MOE scholarship award allocation.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from elite Pakistani institutions (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, UET) with high GRE scores (325+), first-author publications, and strong mathematical foundations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Strong Pakistani alumni presence in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, and Biomedical Engineering at NUS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Pakistan, Indonesia, South Korea, United States.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized websites claiming direct NUS admissions: nus-scholarships-direct.org, singapore-student-portal.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of SGD $50 is paid only through the official NUS GDA3 portal. The scholarship itself has no additional fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: NUS has no commercial agents and does not work with third-party education consultants.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Singapore Student's Pass application and issuance fee (SGD $90 / ~PKR 19,000)
Airfare Pakistan to Singapore Changi (~PKR 160,000 to 240,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: Master's students get the same stipend as PhDs. (Truth: PhD stipend is SGD $2,200-$2,700/mo; Master's by Research stipend is SGD $1,500/mo).
MYTH: You cannot work in Singapore after graduation. (Truth: PhD graduates under MOE tuition grants are highly sought after by Singaporean tech firms and research institutes).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial blogs state GRE is optional for everyone; NUS strictly requires GRE General for graduates of non-Singaporean universities.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum Cumulative Average Point (CAP) of 3.50 out of 5.00 for Master's and 3.80 out of 5.00 for PhD.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at NUS campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Must pass PhD Qualifying Examination (QE) within 18 to 24 months to advance to doctoral candidacy and receive higher stipend rate.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Must contribute up to 6 hours per week of departmental teaching or research assistance; outside employment prohibited without approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars receiving MOE tuition grant are free to work in Singapore or globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None for PhD research scholarship holders.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if student drops out or CAP drops below threshold for two consecutive semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both department heads and Faculty Dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 4 years for PhD; extensions beyond 48 months must be funded by supervisor research grants.
